content.value: Dust's latest capability, structured data analysis with table queries, marks a significant leap forward to help anyone in the company make the most of data. This feature enables AI agents to generate and execute SQL queries on structured data sources like CSV files, Notion databases, and Google Sheets, opening up new quantitative analysis avenues.

You were explicit in your fondness for Dust's swift semantic search capabilities for your company's knowledge base, and also in your wish for a powerful structured data analysis tool. Dust do it. Dust now introduces SQL query generation for structured data analysis, distinct from, but complementary to, our semantic search functionality.
Using Table Queries
Dust offers two primary methods to leverage table queries:
Manual Table Creation
: Users can upload CSV files or utilize Dust’s API to create tables within folders.
Automatic Table Discovery

: If you created a Connection with Google Drive or Notion, Dust seamlessly discovers tables from Google Sheets and Notion Databases. This integration ensures that your data is always up-to-date and ready for analysis without the need for manual intervention.
What are Real-Life Applications of Structured Data in Dust
Structured data analysis with Dust can transform workflows and power new use cases across teams:
Pipeline Management in a Notion DB
Track your interactions with candidates, freelancers, and partners by querying your Notion database for real-time insights.
Meet John from the Marketing team.
John needs to track their engagement with freelancers across various projects. John created a custom agent @great_freelancers.
